summary: Backend + frontend regression of CloudPay's provider-agnostic architecture with generic contract endpoints. Backend: 99/99 pytest tests passed serially (-n0) covering the full generic contract (available, capabilities, health, intent, qr, status, reconcile, webhook), payment engine, and live-mode enforcement. Frontend: Verified via Playwright against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL that (a) Payments screen's New Payment dialog exposes payment-provider-select populated from GET /api/providers/available with option 'Mock Sandbox Provider · sandbox', (b) creating a sandbox payment (ref=TESTui..., amount 100.00) succeeds through the generic engine and renders in the payments table row payment-row-<ref> with status 'succeeded' and provider_txn_id 'mock_...', with success toast 'Payment processed via provider plugin', and (c) Providers screen's Add Provider dialog shows a single Mock option and renders provider-capabilities chips: mode:sandbox, flow:direct, flow:intent, flow:qr, refunds, webhooks.
critical_code_review_comments: Generic provider contract is cleanly composed of building blocks; only Mock is registered in registry.
Frontend Payments dialog correctly wires provider selection to POST /api/payments provider_key; capability display on Providers screen reflects backend capabilities payload.
Live-mode POST /api/providers is rejected with 400 as required.
seed_data_creation: Created one sandbox payment via UI on active tenant (TEST_test9fdeff) with reference TESTui1788267577, amount $100.00, status succeeded via mock provider plugin.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests with `cd /app/backend && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && python -m pytest tests/ -n0 -q` (MUST use -n0). For UI, navigate to Payments/Providers via sidebar link click (not direct page.goto) — SPA routes are under /dashboard/*. Provider selector testids: payment-provider-select + payment-provider-option-mock; Providers dialog testids: add-provider-button, provider-select, provider-capabilities. Only Mock provider is registered by design.
